body:
```suggestion
			If [code]true[/code], the navigation system will print warnings when a navigation mesh with a small cell size is used on a navigation map with a larger size as this commonly causes rasterization errors.
```
The 3D height is irrelevant for 2D

```suggestion
		WARN_PRINT("Navigation map synchronization had " + itos(edge_merge_error_count) + " edge error(s).
More than 2 edges tried to occupy the same map rasterization space.
This causes a logical error in the navigation mesh geometry and is commonly caused by overlap or too densely placed edges.
Consider baking with a higher 'cell_size', greater geometry margin, and less detailed bake objects to cause fewer edges.
Consider lowering the 'navigation/2d/merge_rasterizer_cell_scale' in the project settings.
This warning can be toggled under 'navigation/2d/warnings/navmesh_edge_merge_errors' in the project settings.");
```
"Fewer" is used for countable things, "greater" for uncountable
